text:
Emily (PM): quick sync: infra flagged a 10-14d slip on tenant routing. need a call on cutting vs shifting milestone.
Matt (Eng): is it the kernel regression or infra capacity?
Raj (SRE): driver regression + node availability. hotfix in flight but not guaranteed <2w.
Emily (PM): options: A) remove multi-tenant from MVP and ship single-tenant pilot on time, B) postpone milestone 2 weeks, C) smaller feature cuts elsewhere.
Carla (Sales): pilot customers want isolation; some would accept single-tenant if we surface timeline for multi-tenant.
Sarah (Design): single-tenant simplifies flows; we can show a roadmap banner and hide tenant selection UI behind flag.
Matt (Eng): implementation note: we already have multi-tenant paths in code; toggle off by default and ship single-tenant path. less QA surface.
Theo (Data): we should tag telemetry pilot_variant=single-tenant to compare with later multi-tenant rollout.
Jin (Product Ops): milestone ops: current acceptance criteria say "support multiple tenants in pilot". we can propose an amendment to accept single-tenant + committed v1 plan.
Emily (PM): suggested decision: keep date, ship single-tenant MVP with feature-flagged multi-tenant disabled, add v1 milestone for multi-tenant with firm timeline.
Carla (Sales): okay if we get a one-pager for customers and a committed v1 date.
Matt (Eng): will add the feature flag and telemetry tag. example config for playbook:
```
features.multi_tenant.enabled=false
features.multi_tenant.canary=manual
features.multi_tenant.canary_window=48h
```
Raj (SRE): runbook addition: if canary error rate >0.5% auto rollback and notify #eng-oncall. hold scaling for 48h post-toggle.
Sarah (Design): I'll draft an in-app banner and the copy for customer comms.
Emily (PM): action items: Emily write one-pager (EOD tomorrow), Jin update milestone doc, Matt add flag + telemetry, Raj update runbook, Sarah add UI banner, Carla prep customer outreach.
Jin (Product Ops): I'll create the milestone change request and assign owners.
Carla (Sales): ping me when the one-pager is ready. I'll coordinate with the three pilot customers and set expectations.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled for 2024-06-12T23:40:00Z.
Theo (Data): also request event tag "pilot_orchestration=single-tenant" for rollout diffs.
Matt (Eng): added to PR.
Emily (PM): Decision recap: cut multi-tenant from MVP (feature-flagged off), keep milestone date, create v1 for multi-tenant. reopen if hotfix lands earlier. closing thread.
